body.prompt: Instrumental percussion only, 66 BPM, 4/4. A soft, steady, suspenseful pulse for a secret vote at night: a muted clock-like tick on every beat, a soft brushed snare on beats two and four, a light shaker in eighth notes. No pitched instruments, no melody, no chords, no bass, no fills, no build-up, no ending, the same throughout so it can loop seamlessly.
